top_signals.title: Fast Money Bets on November RBA Hike in Fight Against Inflation
top_signals.summary: Speculative investors are increasingly betting the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise interest rates again in November as inflation remains above the central bank’s target.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: MTR CEO: Hong Kong Core Business Solid
top_signals.summary: Jeny Yeung, CEO at railway operator MTR, says the Hong Kong property market and transport patronage has stabilized. She speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show" after the company posted first-half revenue that beat estimates.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
